tools.name: chat
tools.description: Stateless chat completion across any text model in your org catalog.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate an image from a text prompt.

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Submit an async video generation job. Returns request_id. If a video card is shown it updates itself and you do not need to poll. Otherwise poll with check_video.

tools.name: check_video
tools.description: Poll a video job until complete or failed. Shows text only. Do not call it repeatedly while a video card is on screen, because that card updates itself.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List models visible to your organization.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Get org credit balance or usage reporting.

tools.name: run_app
tools.description: Run a Play app (upscale, transform, etc.) against a prompt.

tools.name: create_run
tools.description: Start a durable OneOver run. It keeps going after the client disconnects. Poll with get_run.

tools.name: get_run
tools.description: Read a durable run and the events after a cursor.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Poll a unified generation job by request_id.

tools.name: build_create
tools.description: Start a Code Studio build: describe a page or small web app and OneOver writes the files. Returns build_id and build_project_id right away; the build keeps running. If a build card is shown it updates itself. Otherwise poll with build_status. The finished page is saved to the account library.

tools.name: build_iterate
tools.description: Send a follow-up instruction to an existing build. Only one build can run on a project at a time.

tools.name: build_status
tools.description: State of a build: running, complete, failed or stopped, plus file list, credits charged, and the share link once published.

tools.name: build_get_files
tools.description: Read the files of a build. Pass path to read one file.

tools.name: build_stop
tools.description: Stop a running build. Files already written are kept. Safe to call twice.

tools.name: build_publish
tools.description: Publish a build to an unlisted share link at oneover.com/p/<slug>. Needs an HTML file.
